result.topic_en:
Draft notes, written over a printed postal ledger form, on the conditions for a function $\chi(s,z)$ to be divisible by $\psi(s^
u,z^\mu)$ and on counting the order of infinity, the zeros and the number of arbitrary constants of such functions for $
u\ge n-1$, $\mu\ge m-1$.

methods.what: For the quotient of two polynomials to stay finite at infinity, they must have equal degree; express $s'$ as $\chi/\psi$ with $\nu\ge n-1$, $\mu\ge m-1$
methods.quote:
der Ausdruck, durch welchen $s'$ dargestellt
werden soll, sei daher von der Form $\frac{\chi}{\psi}(s,z)$ und $\nu \geqq n-1$, $\mu \geqq m-1$

methods.what: The adjoint conditions: $\chi$ and $\psi$ must vanish at the $r$ double points $(\gamma_\varrho,\delta_\varrho)$
methods.quote:
Es müssen also die Functionen $\chi$ und $\psi$ für die $r$ Werthsysteme
$(s=\gamma_\varrho, z=\delta_\varrho)$ verschwinden.

methods.what: The norm $\Pi_\chi(z)$ of $\chi$ is a polynomial of degree $m\nu+n\mu$
methods.quote: $\Pi_\chi(z) = a_0^\nu \chi(s^{(1)}) \chi(s^{(2)}) \cdots \chi(s^{(n)}) = 0$ wird für ein unendliches $z$ unendlich von der Ordnung $m\nu + n\mu$
